name: Unchained Rogue Shifting Spy
body:
Some doppelkin rogues learn to use their innate abilities to aid more directly in their abilities.

Requirement: A shifting spy must be a doppelkin.

Social Intuition (Ex)

A doppelkin already has innate social adaptability and the shifting spy leans into these skills at the expense of some of their mechanical abilities. At 1st level, getting a hunch in a social situation takes 1 round instead of 1 minute, gathering information with Diplomacy takes half the time, and the shifting spy can take 10 on Bluff, Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Sense Motive checks even when they are normally unable. This ability replaces trapfinding.

Fact-Keeper (Ex)

At 3rd level, a shifting spy picks up all kinds of information in their travels and missions. They gain a +1 bonus on all trained Knowledge checks. This bonus increases by +1 for every 3 levels thereafter. This ability replaces danger sense.

Shifting Anatomy (Ex)

At 4th level, a shifting spy uses their ability to change their form to change the locations of their vital organs on the fly. They gain a 25% change to avoid a critical hit or precision damage. This improves to 50% at 8th level. This ability replaces uncanny dodge and improved uncanny dodge.
